ad_info.structure_source: library format F70 (Ingrediente que se derrama sobre el producto con dos titulares a los lados) — estructuras/xt-01.json
ad_info.reference_style: Premium still life: hero ingredient pouring over the product, two side headlines, a technical data column
ad_info.angle_used: Característica estrella — Amazon aguaje plus triple action (pain: fear of surgery or injections)

global_identity.color_palette: Brand palette taken from the bottle: hot fuchsia #E6177F (main accent), deep magenta #B0105E, dark plum #2B1226 (deep backgrounds and header blocks), bottle black #0E0E10, bubblegum pink #FF8CC0 (accent text and highlighted words), pale blush pink #FBE3EE (light pills, cards and soft surfaces) and white #FFFFFF for main texts. Secondary support for this variation: aguaje pulp orange #F28C28 and fruit-skin maroon #6B1E1E.
global_identity.visual_style: Premium photographic still life with a real-photo inset; the real bottle sharp and identical to the photo.
global_identity.visual_atmosphere: Fresh, natural and premium; Amazon fruit energy, warm and honest.
global_identity.graphic_language: Clean blush background, a thick glossy orange pulp stream, two bold side headlines, an italic data column, a rounded photo card with a thin fuchsia border, a bold bottom band with a bordered badge.
global_identity.text_typography: Headlines in a very heavy condensed geometric sans-serif (Montserrat Black / condensed look), uppercase; data and secondary texts in Poppins Bold Italic and Poppins Regular.

creative_objective: Make the natural origin visible and premium: a real cut aguaje fruit pouring its orange pulp toward the closed bottle, with the two key features on the sides (Amazon aguaje, triple action) and the dosage data, while a real-photo inset shows the mom in the fitting room with jeans loose at the hips, the pain that makes her want a natural option instead of a surgery.

art_direction.design_quality: Premium, polished, modern, scroll-stopping, professionally designed, commercially strong
art_direction.visual_hierarchy: 1) the fruit and the orange stream, 2) the two side headlines, 3) the bottle, 4) the real-photo inset, 5) the data column, 6) the bottom band.
art_direction.composition_style: Vertical axis in the center: fruit at top center (cropped by the top edge), stream falling down the center, bottle at bottom center; headlines left and right of the stream; data column far left; photo inset bottom right.
art_direction.spacing_and_structure: Symmetric side headlines at the same height; the stream passes between them; 5% outer margins; the inset card does not overlap the bottle.
art_direction.lighting_and_depth: Soft studio key light from the upper left, glossy highlights on the pulp, soft contact shadow under the bottle; the inset keeps natural fitting-room light.
art_direction.conversion_feel: The ad must feel persuasive, eye-catching, emotionally engaging, credible, elegant and commercially strong

reference_structure_analysis.layout_summary: Top 33%: a big halved fruit cropped by the top edge pouring a thick glossy stream that falls down the center. Middle 30%: two headlines on each side of the stream (left in color, right in black) each with a small detail line underneath. Left column: four short data pairs in bold italic + regular. Bottom 37%: the product receiving the stream at the center and, on the right, a hand with the prepared product (here replaced by the real-photo inset of the pain scene). Added by batch rule: a slim bottom band with 'Pagas al recibir' and the registration badge.

fuchsia condensed headline and its detail
plum condensed headline and its detail
four true data pairs from the label
the real closed bottle; the stream lands behind it, never covers the label

detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: human element; here the mandatory pain scene

forbidden_additions: Loose capsules, powders spilled as capsules, an open bottle, a shaker or drink

visual_prompt: Square 1:1 premium still life on a smooth pale blush #FBE3EE seamless background with a very soft vignette. TOP ZONE (0–35%): a large real aguaje fruit (moriche palm fruit: oval, about the size of an egg, covered in glossy overlapping maroon-brown #6B1E1E scales like a snake skin) cut in half, hanging upside down at top center and cropped by the top edge, its thin layer of bright orange #F28C28 pulp visible, pouring one thick glossy orange pulp stream that narrows and falls straight down the center of the canvas, with a few small orange droplets, photographic, ultra sharp. MIDDLE ZONE (30–52%): on the LEFT of the stream, a 2-line headline in hot fuchsia #E6177F Montserrat Black condensed uppercase, with a small detail line under it in fuchsia Poppins Regular; on the RIGHT of the stream, a 2-line headline in dark plum #2B1226 Montserrat Black condensed uppercase, right-aligned, with a 2-line detail under it in plum Poppins Regular. Both headlines at the same height, about 9% of the canvas tall each line. LEFT DATA COLUMN (55–86%, 4% from the left edge): four stacked data pairs, each a bold italic plum value on top (Poppins Bold Italic) and a regular italic plum word below. BOTTOM CENTER (52–90%): the real product bottle standing upright, facing the camera, about 36% of the canvas height, centered under the stream; the orange stream lands just behind the cap and pools softly at the base behind the bottle with a small glossy splash, never covering the label; soft contact shadow. PRODUCT: use the attached product image as the only source of truth for the bottle; do not redesign, replace or reinterpret it. A matte black cylindrical plastic supplement bottle, about 1.6 times taller than wide, with straight vertical sides and no neck: a wide-mouth bottle whose glossy hot-pink/magenta screw cap is almost as wide as the body (about 90% of its width) and about one fifth of the total height, printed with a repeating small white 'VITALABH' wordmark pattern; not a slim bottle and not a squat jar. A solid hot-pink band wraps the bottom fifth. The black label shows a small pink VITALABH emblem, a huge bold white condensed 'AGUAJE', 'COMPLEX 3 EN 1' with '3 EN 1' in pink-red, a thin hot-pink banner, a bold italic hot-pink 'TRIPLE ACCIÓN' with a swoosh, three pink-outlined boxes '200mg AGUAJE' + '400mg FENOGRECO' + '200mg MACA NEGRA', and '60 CÁPSULAS' at the bottom. Matte finish, no rainbow, no prism light, no lens flare; always closed; the label reads the right way round, never mirrored. BOTTOM RIGHT (55–90% height, 66–96% width, about 26% of the canvas with its card): a rounded-corner photo card with a thin hot-fuchsia border and a soft shadow, slightly tilted 3 degrees, showing an ultra-realistic smartphone photo: a Colombian mom in her late 30s with real skin texture and pores, no studio makeup, shoulder-length dark wavy hair with loose strands, wearing a wrinkled white cotton t-shirt and mid-blue jeans that hang loose at the hips and the back: a baggy fold of extra denim below the seat, drooping back pockets, flat straight line from waist to thigh; she stands three-quarters turned in a small store fitting room with a curtain and a mirror, looking back over her shoulder at her reflection with a disappointed frown, one hand pulling the loose waistband; warm natural overhead light, slight phone-camera grain; her other hand is empty. BOTTOM BAND (90–100%): full-width dark plum #2B1226 band: left, white Montserrat Black 'PAGAS AL RECIBIR' with a small white hand-and-coin line icon; right, a rounded badge with a solid hot-fuchsia border and a small white shield icon containing the registration text in white Poppins Bold on two lines. All texts crisp, spelled exactly with correct accents, nothing else written.

mandatory_visual_elements: Halved real aguaje fruit with maroon scales and orange pulp at top center, cropped by the top edge, pouring a thick orange stream down the center
The real closed product bottle at bottom center, label fully visible, the stream landing behind it
Left data column with four data pairs
Rounded real-photo card bottom right: mom in a fitting room with jeans loose at the hips and back, disappointed look
Dark plum bottom band with 'PAGAS AL RECIBIR' and a bordered registration badge
final_generation_exclusions: No loose capsules, no pills, no open bottle, no shaker, no drink, no other product or brand
The pulp never covers or hides the label
No prices, percentages, ratings, testimonials or 'envío gratis'
No logos; never write the words 'AGREGAR' or 'LOGO Y SELLO DE'
Do not add any visual module that is not described in this prompt.
Do not add any text that is not listed in the EXACT VISIBLE TEXT section.

Do not add CTA buttons, prices, badges, benefits, icons, trust seals, ratings, testimonials, discount labels, offer boxes or extra claims unless they are explicitly listed in detected_visual_blocks or text_layers.
Preserve the translated structure exactly. Do not complete or improve the layout with additional advertising elements.
meta_policy_check: All visible text has been sanitized for Facebook/Instagram Ads compliance. Only label facts (ingredients, amounts, vitamins, dosage); no body-change promises, no guarantees, no personal attribute callouts.
language_rule: All visible text inside the generated image must be written in Spanish (Colombia).
